title: TERMINAL BELOW
notes: Pixel boundary trace from the supplied illustration. Major anchors and relative proportions are direct; small wall jogs have about 5-8px uncertainty because of shadows and wall-top thickness.

This is an enclosed metro terminal. Preserve the north-south long station, two parallel trains, long platforms, central sightline, one transverse bridge and two side service loops. Do not turn it into an outdoor campus.
No large bridge stair towers are visible. Bridge elevation is suggested but not dimensioned; use compact endpoint access, not invented external stair buildings.
Outer perimeter includes the dark but playable rotation corridors. Dark flooring is not automatically a void.
